title: Japan 2026 (Reiwa 8) Year-End Tax Adjustment & Payroll CSV Auditor Input

employees.title: Employee Payroll Records (JSON Array)
employees.description: Array of employee payroll records using either English snake_case keys (employee_id, salary_yen, dep1_age, dep1_salary_yen, declared_basic_deduction_yen, ...) or Japanese HR CSV headers (社員番号, 給与収入, 子1年齢, 子1給与収入, 申告_基礎控除, ...).

csvText.title: Inline Payroll CSV Text (Optional)
csvText.description: Optional raw CSV string (Japanese HR headers or English headers) to audit alongside or instead of `employees`.

csvBase64.title: Base64-Encoded UTF-8 or Shift-JIS (cp932) CSV Bytes (Optional)
csvBase64.description: Optional Base64-encoded payroll CSV file exported from Yayoi / Bugyo / SmartHR / freee (UTF-8-BOM or Shift-JIS cp932 auto-detected).

includeWallSimulation.title: Include 10-Point Wall Simulation (103M-207M Yen) per Employee
includeWallSimulation.description: When true, attaches the 10-checkpoint household take-home & deduction simulation table to each employee output item.
